descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-14 step 4 + ER 3; UAT OAT-03 step 5; TFA-92592 AC 15 · “Generation runs on the server: on return, the note is there, or an explicit failure shows.”. Mixed: stated part — note or explicit failure on return, dictation kept; our part — the second patient getting none of the first patient's text or note (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug N17 · fixed on 8b4be94a · was S1 · no longer counted

Generation is not on the server: the note is still written and saved by the page, so a reload, a closed tab or a killed phone page loses a note the model already wrote; no 'generating' state on return, a failure while away is never shown, and the previous note stays on Post-Round as if it were today's

Tickets: TFA-92592 AC 15 · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: 'use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only billing to the server. Confirmed on dev (TC-14/S07 reload: Haiku answered, no note saved). Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: fixed: the note is a server job; reload or leaving during Generate shows a generating state, then the note (dev: OAT-03/S15, TC-14/S07, S26, TC-21/S28 10/10, TC-17/S27).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-14/S26, OAT-03/S15, TC-25/S14, TC-21/S28, TC-17/S27

Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S07 Tap Generate, then leave for another patient, reload or close the tab: on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows, and nothing lands on the other patient

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Generation runs on the server: the physician can tap Generate and move to another patient; the Post-Round tab shows a 'generating' state, and on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows, … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.5; TFA-92592 AC 15) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U10 Generate AI Note moves the physician to Post-Round with the generated note there. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T8 If both models fail, a clear error shows and the dictation is not lost (Empty & Failure States: 'Note not generated' shown, dictation kept; … (TFA-94422 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT OAT-03)
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fresh physician; two patients per mode with no note and no tasks ({hospitalPatient}, {hospitalPatient2}, {snfResident}, {snfResident2}). Each cell's dictation carries its own blood pressure, so a checkpoint can tell this cell's note from an earlier one

When Cell A (Hospital, leave): on {hospitalPatient} type the cell-A text, press Generate Note & Finish, at once open {hospitalPatient2}; stay 45 s; check its Post-Round and Encounter tabs; return, open Post-Round at once and again after 30 s, then the Encounter tab. …

Then On every return Post-Round shows this cell's note (its blood pressure) or an explicit failure, never only 'Complete the Encounter tab first'; right after returning it shows the note, a generating state or the failure; the dictation is still on the Encounter tab, also after the reload and after the tab was closed; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint below. A note checkpoint passes on this cell's blood pressure ('131/77' or '131 over 77', and so on) or an accepted failure string ('Note not generated', 'couldn’t be generated', 'could not be generated'; exact wording Q18), never on 'Generated clinical note' alone, which an earlier note also shows. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-14/S07

Tap Generate, then leave for another patient, reload or close the tab: on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows, and nothing lands on the other patient

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for qa); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

PW, local stack, one fresh physician per mode; ai/notes:generateNote mocked at the Convex socket and answered 8 s after it is asked with a note that carries the dictation (so each cell's blood pressure tells its note apart). Every Generate used a 'procedure-other' custom note template because on 43c38a4f saving a generated note queues a server billing job (billing/persistence.ts enqueueBilling → ai/billing.ts run) that no socket mock can answer and that would reach Bedrock on this stack; the template only changes the (mocked) model's instruction text. Tripwire: no model call at all during the run. Cell A (Hospital, Generate then the app's back arrow and the list to a second patient, 45 s there, back): passed 8/8 — the second patient never showed or stored anything of the first (Post-Round 'No note generated yet', no note / noteGeneratedAt / encounter text), and on return the first patient's Post-Round showed its own note (131/77) at once and 30 s later, dictation kept. Cell C (Nursing Home, same): passed 8/8. Cell B (Hospital, Generate, reload while the generateNote request is in flight, 144 ms after the press): FAILED — 45 s later Post-Round shows only 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' with the finalize button spinning 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' (B27); no note was stored (status stays 'seen'); the dictation is kept. Cell D (both modes, Regenerate with new dictation, open a new tab and close the old one): FAILED in both — 45 s later Post-Round still shows the previous note (131/77, 127/69) as the current note with no sign that the regenerate was lost, while the stored encounter text is the new dictation (136/84, 133/71). On 43c38a4f the note is still generated by the page: the browser calls ai/notes:generateNote, gets the text back and saves it with its own mutation (useNoteGeneration.ts finalize, snf EncounterTab.tsx handleGenerate); 'feat: use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only the billing suggestion to a server job (no scheduler use for notes anywhere in convex/). Judged 20/23 (failures b1, d1, d3; the B27 spinner is recorded only). Dev confirmation of cell B with the real backend: runs/2026-10-14-dev/newspec-c/results.gen.json TC-14/S07.

Product issue: A physician who taps Generate Note & Finish and then reloads, closes the tab, or (on a phone) has the page killed loses the note silently: on return Post-Round says 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' with a spinning 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' button, and after a Regenerate the old note is shown as if it were current. The dictation is kept, so Generate can be pressed again.

Evidence: 20 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: browser-events, action-timing. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):
